edges.reason: The potted fern is inside the forest cabin whose exterior walls are birch_wood logs to be collected
Crafting a birch_sign requires birch planks, which are converted from the birch_wood logs found at the cabin
Cyan stained glass observatory wall overlooks the underwater coral reef where horn coral is located
Horn coral is in the same coral reef; finding it reveals the nearby dead fire coral blocks available for mining
The bell marks the village center; the birch_door is on a nearby building, using the bell as a navigational landmark
The birch_door building is adjacent to the river gap where the bridge must be constructed
Mined coarse dirt blocks serve as stable building material for the bridge (won't convert on water contact)
Mined concrete powder provides additional bridge material (converts to concrete when placed on water, still forms solid surface)

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_fern is at spawn-relative (-10, 1, -10) inside the forest cabin. Player must enter the cabin through the south wall opening and face the fern. max_distance=4 ensures the player is inside the small 3x3 cabin interior.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Target is the north wall interior at (-10, 2, -12) which the player sees after entering the cabin. This prevents accidental satisfaction from the entrance side since the player must be inside facing the far wall. max_distance=5 keeps it within cabin proximity.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch_sign (6 birch planks + 1 stick on crafting table) produces signs that appear in the player's inventory. The crafted item is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan_stained_glass observatory wall center is at (7, 1, 10). max_distance=5 requires close approach to the wall rather than just passing by at a distance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Horn coral blocks are underwater at (11, -2, 10). max_distance=6 (reduced from 10 per validator feedback) requires the player to actually approach the reef by swimming or getting close to the water surface above it, rather than just standing at the observatory.
Uses inventory_has because dead fire coral blocks drop themselves when mined with any pickaxe (no silk touch required). The mined block appears in inventory. Player has iron_pickaxe provided.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The bell is at (8, 2, -2) on a cobblestone_wall post in the village center. max_distance=6 allows the player to see the elevated bell from a reasonable distance while still requiring navigation to the village area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch_door is on the south face of the cobblestone building at (12, 1, -4). max_distance=6 requires approaching the building front.
Uses inventory_has because coarse_dirt drops itself when mined with any tool (shovel is fastest). The mined block appears in inventory. 5 coarse_dirt blocks are available at z=2 near the river gap.

Uses inventory_has because light_blue_concrete_powder drops itself when mined with a shovel. It only converts to concrete when PLACED adjacent to water, not when mined. 5 blocks available at z=2 (safely separated from water at z=5 by grass buffer).

Uses count_in_box_at_least because building a bridge requires placing solid blocks in the river gap. The gap spans z=5-7 at y=-1 to y=0. Two rules with AND logic: (1) at least 1 coarse_dirt block in the gap confirms stable material placement, (2) at least 1 light_blue_concrete block confirms the player also used concrete powder (which converts to concrete on water contact). AND logic validates both dependency paths (mine coarse_dirt -> bridge AND mine concrete_powder -> bridge). The task_text explicitly instructs using both materials. Box is generous (x=-4 to 4, y=-1 to 0, z=5 to 7) covering the full gap area.

scene_description: A compact multi-zone scene with three parallel task branches: (1) Northwest - birch wood forest cabin with potted fern inside, supporting the crafting chain. (2) East - village with bell on stone post and cobblestone building with birch_door, adjacent to a river gap requiring bridge construction. (3) Southeast - underwater coral reef with horn_coral_blocks and dead_fire_coral_blocks, viewable through cyan stained glass observatory wall. Mining materials (coarse dirt and light blue concrete powder) are placed at z=2 near the river gap with a grass buffer preventing water contact.
task_text: Explore a village near a forest and coral reef to complete these objectives: (1) Enter the forest cabin and find the potted fern inside. (2) Mine birch wood logs from the cabin walls — each log converts to 4 birch planks on a crafting table. (3) Place your crafting table, convert logs to planks, then craft a birch sign (6 birch planks in top 2 rows + 1 stick in bottom center). (4) Find the cyan stained glass observatory wall and look through it to spot the coral reef. (5) Swim to the reef and find the yellow horn coral. (6) Mine a dead fire coral block from the reef using your pickaxe. (7) Find the village bell on its stone post. (8) Locate the birch door on the building next to the river. (9) Mine coarse dirt blocks near the river gap. (10) Mine light blue concrete powder blocks near the gap. (11) Build a walkable bridge of at least 3 blocks spanning the river gap using both mined materials (note: concrete powder becomes solid concrete when placed on water).
design_notes: FINAL VERSION - All critiques addressed. Layout: Player spawns at (0,0,0). NORTHWEST CABIN (x=-12 to -8, z=-12 to -8): Birch_wood walls (y=1-3), oak_plank floor (y=0) and roof (y=4), 3x3 interior (y=1-2 air), potted_fern at (-10,1,-10), entrance 1x3 opening on south wall at (-10, y=1-3, z=-8). EAST VILLAGE (x=8-14, z=-4 to 0): Bell on cobblestone→wall→bell stack at (8, y=0-2, z=-2), cobblestone building (5x5x4) with birch_door facing south at (12, y=1-2, z=-4). SOUTH RIVER GAP (x=-3 to 3, z=5-7): 7 blocks wide, water at y=-2, air at y=-1, stone floor at y=-3. MINING MATERIALS at z=2: 5 coarse_dirt blocks (west side), 5 light_blue_concrete_powder blocks (east side), with grass_block buffer at z=3-4 separating from water at z=5. SOUTHEAST CORAL REEF (x=8-14, z=8-14): Sand floor at y=-3, water y=-2 to y=0, 3 horn_coral_blocks + 2 horn_coral fans at y=-2 around (10-12, -2, 10-11), 4 dead_fire_coral_blocks at y=-2 around (11-13, -2, 11-12). OBSERVATORY WALL at (7, y=0-2, z=8-12): Stone brick wall with 2x3 cyan_stained_glass window at (7, y=1-2, z=9-11) facing east toward coral. PLAYER INVENTORY: iron_pickaxe, iron_shovel, crafting_table, 4 sticks.
